look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Trace the climbing green vine to a leaf stalk: paired curling tendrils emerge near the petiole base, while stout sharp prickles often arm the green stems. Check the broad, often triangular or hastate, leathery leaves for several strong veins radiating from the base. Leaf shape is variable; tendril placement and stem armature are more useful than one leaf outline.
